### It Will Pierce Our Souls, Whether We Like It or Not
Author: Binu Samuel
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-august-6-2021.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 31:12
Points:
- Even when children seem bored or disinterested, God's truth still takes root in their hearts.
- Moses commanded all Israelites, including young children and foreigners, to assemble and hear God's word.
- God understands human limitations and still chooses scripture reading to shape young minds.
- Faithful parents and teachers should persevere in sharing God's word even without immediate visible results.
- Scripture carries divine power that will not return void or fail to accomplish its purpose.

### The Old Covenant Law
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/old-covenant-law
Passage: Deuteronomy 31:9-13
Points:
- Moses commanded the public reading of the law every seven years during the Feast of Booths.
- Hearing God's statutes during a harvest festival helped Israel connect obedience with gladness and joy.
- Recalling the wilderness shelters reminded the people of God's unearned grace in delivering them from slavery.
- The law was provided not to merit salvation, but as a grateful response to redemption.
- True faith avoids legalism by resting in Christ while living out good works in thankfulness.
